column2: lsm: Add check for BPF LSM return value

column1: A bpf prog returning a positive number attached to file_alloc_security
This happens because file system can not filter out the positive number
returned by the LSM prog using IS_ERR
Given that hook file_alloc_security never returned positive number
before the introduction of BPF LSM
column2: and other BPF LSM hooks may
this patch adds LSM return value check
to ensure no unexpected value is returned.
